title: Shared Latent Structures Enable Unified Backdoor Detection and Mitigation in LLMs
reasoning: The paper investigates the mechanistic basis of backdoors in Large Language Models using sparse autoencoders. While it includes 'bias induction' and 'harmful advice' as examples of malicious behaviors to detect and mitigate, its focus is on the technical latent structures of these attacks rather than evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethical reasoning frameworks.
